EC1: Endoscopically confirmed gastric [OR] and/or duodenal ulcers on Day 1.
EC2: Endoscopically confirmed active upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage on Day 1.
EC3: Current [OR] or past history of aspirin-induced asthma [OR] or hypersensitivity to NSAIDs.
EC4: Past or planned surgery affecting gastric acid secretion.
EC5: Clinically significant hepatic [OR] or renal disorder.
EC6: Serious cardiac dysfunction [OR], hypertension [OR], or hematological disorder.
